class.name: SlugVector
class.brief_description: GPU vector data parsed from an SVG file, for use with [SlugVector3D].
class.description: SlugVector parses an SVG document into filled regions and packs their Bézier outlines into the same GPU atlas used for text, so [SlugVector3D] can draw them resolution-independently with the Slug algorithm. Each shape element with a solid fill becomes one region; its subpaths (including holes) stay together, so non-zero winding cancels them as authored. Parsing is done with NanoSVG, which bakes element and group transforms into the points. Y is flipped so the result is y-up, matching the rest of the pipeline. Gradients, strokes and the even-odd fill rule are not supported yet: such elements are skipped (or would render as if non-zero). The data is not built eagerly: parsing and atlas packing happen lazily, the first time a [SlugVector3D] needs them.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the bounding box of all parsed shapes, in SVG user units (y-up). Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: get_build_time_usec
method.description: Returns how long the last parse and build of this vector's GPU data took, in microseconds. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: get_max_curves_per_band
method.description: Returns the largest number of curves found in any single band of any shape, a measure of the worst-case per-pixel cost when rasterizing this vector. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: get_shape_count
method.description: Returns the number of filled regions parsed from the SVG. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the SVG was read and parsed into at least one visible solid-filled region. Triggers the build if it hasn't happened yet.

members.member: Path to the SVG file to parse, for example [code]res://icon.svg[/code].
